name: amass
title: OWASP Amass
description: OWASP Amass — comprehensive subdomain enumeration and DNS reconnaissance. Set AMASS_DOMAIN to the apex domain (no scheme, e.g. faradaysec.com). AMASS_PASSIVE=true restricts to non-touching sources for stealth. AMASS_TIMEOUT caps the run in minutes. AMASS_RESOLVERS is a list of DNS resolvers (e.g. 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8, 9.9.9.9). Emits one Faraday host per unique IP with all subdomains pointing at it as hostnames.
